items.headline: Robinson throws 3TDs, Albert has 3 INTs and Anderson wins in his Southern Miss head-coaching debut
items.description: — Steven Robinson rushed for three touchdowns and Kobi Albert intercepted three passes as Southern Miss rolled past Alcorn State 49-3 on Saturday to give Blake Anderson his first win as the Golden Eagles' head coach.
